map.：铁锈色痰高度提示大叶性肺炎(肺炎链球菌)，结合高热胸痛经验性抗感染。: : Rust-colored sputum strongly suggests lobar pneumonia (Streptococcus pneumoniae); combined with high fever and chest pain, give empirical antibiotics.
map.：粉红色泡沫痰为急性肺水肿急症，立即坐位吸氧利尿扩血管。: : Pink frothy sputum is a medical emergency sign of acute pulmonary edema — sit the patient up, give oxygen, and use diuretics and vasodilators immediately.

map.中老年咯血查胸部 CT 与支气管镜，排外结核/肺癌。: In older or middle-aged patients with hemoptysis, get a chest CT and bronchoscopy to rule out tuberculosis and lung cancer.
